issue.title: bob bank import -D: import the week's downloads, then delete them
issue.description: `bank import -D ~/Downloads/*.qfx`, typed into Bob Command Mode or a shell, previews the import and the planned deletions. Ctrl+Enter imports the batch, then permanently deletes exactly the source files bob parsed. It deletes them only if the whole batch was recorded and each file is unchanged since bob read it. A refused or failed import keeps every file, and the output says so.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202611/bank_import_delete.md requests this work

issue.title: bob expands ~ and glob patterns in bank import FILE operands
issue.description: expand: add a shared native::host_paths operand expander (tilde, literal-first glob, dedupe, no-match refusal) and adopt it in bob bank import. Also light up the "bank" Command Mode invalidation tag, filter completion to exports, add a macOS privacy hint for unreadable files, and document file patterns.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/bank_import_delete.md defines phase expand as one work unit

issue.title: The -D/--delete flag, its delete gate, output, JSON, and docs
issue.description: delete: add -D/--delete with an up-front check of each file, a gate that deletes only after the batch succeeds and only files whose bytes still match their digest, per-file outcomes, colored human output, an additive JSON `delete` object, exit codes, and the docs/bank.md and Monday guide rewrite.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/bank_import_delete.md defines phase delete as one work unit

issue.title: Bank card weekly-import button opens the Command Mode preview
issue.description: card: in bob-plugins, turn the bank queue card's static "Weekly import" footer text into a one-click chip. The chip opens the Command Mode preview of `bank import -D ~/Downloads/*.qfx` and shows a fallback notice only when Command Mode is unavailable.
